channel.title: Software & Features :: Swing Catalyst Support
channel.description: Learn how to use Swing Catalyst’s software features, from recording and exporting sessions to motion capture analysis and data visualization. Recording & Export Record lessons, export videos, and share sessions with students and coaches. Motion Capture Set up and use motion capture for 3D body tracking and swing analysis. Data & Analysis Understand force vectors, key metrics, graphs, and data visualization tools. Setup & Configuration Configure keyboard shortcuts, feedback screens, and application settings.
